a.lede: 3x the vapor-chamber surface area can only do so much; luckily the fridge helped with sustained performance
a.title: iPhone 18 Pro benchmark boosted by giving it a cold drink

b.lede: Matt Birchler put a cold drink can on the back of an iPhone 18 Pro to see how much performance uplift it would get in a prolonged benchmarking session. The results showed up to 25% higher sustained performance from the cold drink, showing the effectiveness of 'liquid cooling.'
b.title: Enthusiast cooled iPhone 18 Pro with cold can of La Croix sparkling water; benchmarks show 25% higher sustained performance
